command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$probe=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("hc-settings-nav2-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID+".py")
@'
import subprocess,time
from pywinauto import Desktop
def until(fn,label,seconds=20):
    end=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(label)
for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows():
    if x.window_text() in ("설정","Settings"):
        try:x.close()
        except Exception:pass
time.sleep(1.5)
subprocess.Popen(["cmd","/c","start","","ms-settings:"])
def settings():
    ws=[x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows() if x.window_text() in ("설정","Settings")]
    return ws[-1] if ws else None
win=until(settings,"Settings window missing")
def find_access():
    for e in win.descendants(control_type="ListItem"):
        if (e.window_text() or "").strip() in ("접근성","Accessibility"):
            return e
    return None
acc=until(find_access,"Accessibility nav item missing")
print("ACCESS_ITEM",acc.element_info.control_type,repr(acc.window_text()),flush=True)
acc.click_input()
time.sleep(2)
matches=[]
for e in win.descendants():
    info=e.element_info
    name=(info.name or "").strip()
    if name in ("대비 테마","Contrast themes"):
        matches.append((info.control_type,name,info.automation_id,hex(e.handle)))
print("CONTRAST_MATCHES",matches,flush=True)
for e in win.descendants():
    info=e.element_info
    name=(info.name or "").strip()
    if ("대비" in name or "contrast" in name.lower()) and info.control_type in ("Button","Group","ListItem","Text"):
        print("CONTRAST_CANDIDATE",info.control_type,repr(name),repr(info.automation_id),hex(e.handle),flush=True)
try:win.close()
except Exception:pass
print("HIGH_CONTRAST_SETTINGS_NAVIGATION_PROBE_PASS",flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $probe -Encoding UTF8
& python -X utf8 $probe
$code=$LASTEXITCODE
Remove-Item $probe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if($code -ne 0){throw "Settings navigation wrapper probe failed"}
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_SETTINGS_NAVIGATION_WRAPPER_PASS"
